ctgov.note: Most CTgov entries are legacy completed trials supporting commercial products (Caldolor, Vibativ, Vaprisol, Kristalose, Acetadote, Sancuso). Active development is centered on ifetroban.

indications.indication: Cardiomyopathy associated with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD)
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 placebo-controlled; 41 DMD patients randomized to 100 mg/day, 300 mg/day ifetroban or placebo for 12 months. High-dose: +3.3% LVEF vs placebo; +5.4% vs propensity-matched natural history controls (p=0.002). Open-label extension to Month 24/36 ongoing.
indications.trial_status: Phase 2 completed Feb 2025; OLE ongoing. End-of-Phase 2 meeting Sept 2025; Type C meeting Jan 2026; Fast Track granted Feb 2026; Orphan Drug + Rare Pediatric designations granted Nov 2024
key_milestones: Regulatory pathway discussions ongoing for registration trial

indications.trial_design: Phase 2 placebo-controlled oral ifetroban in IPF; >70 subjects enrolled across 17 sites; safety interim analysis completed Nov 2025 with no new safety signals.

indications.indication: Diffuse cutaneous Systemic Sclerosis (SSc) and SSc-associated Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
indications.trial_design: Phase 2; diffuse cutaneous SSc cohort fully enrolled (20 patients, 12-month treatment completed); SSc-PAH cohort enrolled 9 of 14 before closure. Closed to enrollment Feb 2025; cardiac imaging analysis complete.
key_milestones: Topline results for diffuse cutaneous arm expected end of Q1 2026

commercial_product.note: Cumberland is primarily a commercial-stage specialty pharma; pipeline is centered on ifetroban Phase 2 development. CET subsidiary supports earlier-stage academic collaborations.

excluded_legacy_terminated.asset: Ifetroban — malignant solid tumors at high risk of metastatic recurrence (Phase 2)
excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Investigator-initiated (Vanderbilt-Ingram); status ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING with primary completion April 2025; Cumberland is collaborator only, not lead sponsor
